entry.title: European defense startups to raise record $10.5 billion in 2026, Dealroom forecasts
entry.summary: PARIS — European defense startups are forecast to raise a record $10.5 billion of funding this year, roughly four times the $2.6 billion raised a year earlier and led by investments in firms developing drone technology, according to Dealroom, which tracks data on venture capital funding. Defense startup funding in Europe already reached $7.4 billion as of Sept. 20, led by so-called “mega rounds” raised by Germany’s Helsing and Quantum systems, Dealroom and Resilience Media said in their annual State of Defence Tech report published Monday. 关键事实：PARIS — European defense startups are forecast to raise a record $10.5 billion of funding this year；roughly four times the $2.6 billion raised a year earlier；led by investments in firms developing drone technology

entry.title: Extreme Environments Push Chips To Their Breaking Point
entry.summary: Orbital data centers, military/aerospace vehicles, HPC experiments, quantum, and advanced manufacturing equipment are all putting pressure on chips to withstand extreme environments. Chips that were once qualified against a limited set of operating conditions are now being designed for environments where multiple stresses hit at once. Radiation, thermal shock, vibration, pressure, noise, and cryogenic temperatures are colliding in applications ranging from orbital data centers and defense systems to particle physics, quantum computing, and advanced manufacturing. 关键事实：Orbital data centers；military/aerospace vehicles；HPC experiments

entry.title: Ukraine says Russian drone attack sinks ship in Romanian waters
entry.summary: The incident is the latest suspected Russian drone incursion, as fears grow that the war in Ukraine could spill over. Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has blamed a Russian drone attack for the sinking of a ship in Romania’s section of the Black Sea. Romania reported that two people were killed and 11 rescued when a grain ship caught fire and sank in its waters on Monday. The Ukrainian president’s claim suggests the incident is the latest in a series of suspected incursions along NATO’s eastern flank, and will fuel concerns that Moscow’s war in Ukraine could spill over. 关键事实：The incident is the latest suspected Russian drone incursion；as fears grow that the war in Ukraine could spill over；Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has blamed a Russian drone attack for the sinking of a ship in Romania’s section of the Black Sea

entry.title: Kraken and Saab team up for drone detection aboard uncrewed vessels
entry.summary: Kraken Technology Group and Saab UK have tested a prototype autonomous ‘drone seeker’ vessel for maritime environments. The experimental vessel combines Kraken’s K3 SCOUT uncrewed surface vessel with Saab UK’s Giraffe 1X radar designed to detect and track airborne threats in real time. Integrated into K3 SCOUT’s modular payload bay, Giraffe 1X is designed to provide early warning of aerial threats, detecting even small airborne targets at extended ranges. entry.title: Suspected Second-generation Planet Solves NASA Hubble Cold Case
entry.summary: Diligent sleuthing by astronomers has broken open a cold case in the data archive of NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope. In a study published Monday in Nature Astronomy, researchers report uncovering a surprising chemical clue that indicates the white dwarf star HS 0209+0832 may host a second-generation planet. This artist’s concept depicts a possible explanation for the unusual chemical abundances NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope detected in the HS 0209+0832 system: a second-generation planet orbiting a white dwarf star. entry.title: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT text in the EU but makes it optional for API users worldwide
entry.summary: OpenAI is adding invisible watermarks to ChatGPT text to comply with EU rules. Unlike Anthropic, it will let API customers worldwide turn them off. The EU AI Act reportedly requires AI providers to label generated text in a machine-readable format. OpenAI's answer is textGrain, a technology that embeds an invisible statistical signal in the model's word choices. It works much like Claude's SynthID watermark, which uses Google's open-source technology. OpenAI says it will turn on watermarking for ChatGPT and Codex users in the European Union over the coming weeks. 关键事实：OpenAI is adding invisible watermarks to ChatGPT text to comply with EU rules；it will let API customers worldwide turn them off
